info.title: Wapo API
info.description: WhatsApp messaging infrastructure for your application. Create tenant-scoped API keys, onboard customer numbers, send messages and receive signed events. Read the guides at /docs before using the interactive reference. WhatsApp is the only enabled public channel.

get.description: Businesses inside the authenticated tenant. External customer IDs are unique per tenant. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.

post.description: Create a business inside the authenticated tenant. Supply name and an optional external_customer_id from your application. Duplicate external IDs return 422.

delete.description: Businesses inside the authenticated tenant. External customer IDs are unique per tenant.

get.description: Businesses inside the authenticated tenant. External customer IDs are unique per tenant.
Authorized WhatsApp phone numbers. Access tokens are verified with Meta and encrypted at rest. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.

post.description: Connect an existing WhatsApp Cloud API number. Supply a Meta phone number ID, its WABA ID and an access token authorized for that number. Wapo verifies phone ownership against Meta before encrypting the token. For customer-authorized onboarding, create a setup link instead.

delete.description: Remove the local connection and its encrypted credentials. This does not delete the phone number or business account at Meta.

get.description: Authorized WhatsApp phone numbers. Access tokens are verified with Meta and encrypted at rest.

Event subscriptions signed with HMAC-SHA256. Secrets are accepted on creation and omitted from reads. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.

post.description: Subscribe a public receiver to one or more supported events. secret_key must contain at least 16 characters and is encrypted. The worker signs the raw JSON body using X-Webhook-Signature (hex HMAC-SHA256), identifies the event in X-Webhook-Event and provides a stable event ID in X-Idempotency-Key. Deliveries may be repeated.

delete.description: Event subscriptions signed with HMAC-SHA256. Secrets are accepted on creation and omitted from reads.

get.description: Current tenant identity, enabled channel capabilities and activity totals.
Current tenant identity, enabled channel capabilities and activity totals.

Send and inspect messages. Use an Idempotency-Key to identify a logical send and reconcile uncertain provider outcomes. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Use a stable key per logical send. Same key and body replays the result; a changed body or unresolved send returns 409. No automatic retries.

post.description: Send through an authorized WhatsApp connection. Free-form text requires an open customer service window; otherwise supply an approved template payload. A successful response means Meta accepted the send, not that it was delivered. Use a stable Idempotency-Key. Never assume a provider timeout means failure.

get.description: Send and inspect messages. Use an Idempotency-Key to identify a logical send and reconcile uncertain provider outcomes.
Platform-compatible customer API. POST wraps fields in customer.

post.description: Platform-compatible customer API. POST wraps fields in customer.

get.description: Platform-compatible customer resource.

post.description: Hosted Embedded Signup. Requires own Meta app configuration. Dedicated and Coexistence flows are contract-tested with a fake provider; real Meta approval and acceptance remain required.

get.description: Hosted Embedded Signup. Requires own Meta app configuration. Dedicated and Coexistence flows are contract-tested with a fake provider; real Meta approval and acceptance remain required.
Lists manually registered WhatsApp bindings. Accepts customer_id filter.
ID is Meta phone ID. PATCH supports whatsapp_phone_number.inbound_processing_enabled only. DELETE removes local binding, not the Meta asset.

patch.description: ID is Meta phone ID. PATCH supports whatsapp_phone_number.inbound_processing_enabled only. DELETE removes local binding, not the Meta asset. Provider permissions and resource ownership are required. Graph request/response fields follow the configured Meta version.

delete.description: ID is Meta phone ID. PATCH supports whatsapp_phone_number.inbound_processing_enabled only. DELETE removes local binding, not the Meta asset.

get.description: POST accepts whatsapp_webhook: {url,secret_key,events}. Signatures are hex HMAC-SHA256 over raw body.

post.description: POST accepts whatsapp_webhook: {url,secret_key,events}. Signatures are hex HMAC-SHA256 over raw body. Provider permissions and resource ownership are required. Graph request/response fields follow the configured Meta version.

get.description: Bridge only. Standalone returns 501 rather than invented health. Standalone support is limited: rich health and URL-based media ingestion return 501. An optional upstream bridge may provide these operations.
Platform-compatible history, newest first by ingestion time. Filters: phone_number_id, direction, status, after, limit.

post.description: Bridge only. Standalone returns 501 for resumable media ingest. Standalone support is limited: rich health and URL-based media ingestion return 501. An optional upstream bridge may provide these operations. Provider permissions and resource ownership are required. Graph request/response fields follow the configured Meta version.

get.description: Health checks without authentication. Readiness verifies PostgreSQL connectivity.
Health checks without authentication. Readiness verifies PostgreSQL connectivity.
List stored setup link metadata for the customer. Capability tokens and full URLs are never reconstructed on reads.

post.description: Create a temporary customer authorization link. Both coexistence and dedicated are offered by default. Share data.url. Authorized GET/list callers can retrieve the URL; it is encrypted at rest. The default expiration is 30 days. Returns 503 when the instance Meta application is not configured.

get.description: DELETE revokes the link. Tokens and URLs are only returned at creation.

delete.description: DELETE revokes the link. Tokens and URLs are only returned at creation.

get.description: DELETE revokes the link. Tokens and URLs are only returned at creation.

delete.description: DELETE revokes the link. Tokens and URLs are only returned at creation.

get.description: Filters: connection_id, status. Supports limit and after. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.
Newest first. Supports limit and after. Resource pages default to 50 items; limit accepts 1–100. Follow meta.after while meta.has_more is true.

post.description: Send a text reply through the conversation connection. WhatsApp messaging-window rules apply. Supply a stable Idempotency-Key to identify the logical reply.

get.description: Full tenant access. Secret is returned only at creation; storage retains a hash.

post.description: Create a credential with full API access to the current tenant. The complete key is returned once. Only its hash and display prefix are stored.

get.description: Full tenant access. Secret is returned only at creation; storage retains a hash.

post.summary: Create a key for a tenant
post.description: Full tenant access. Secret is returned only at creation; storage retains a hash.

get.description: List projects visible to the caller. Platform administrators and operator keys see all projects. Other authenticated console users see their assigned projects, or all projects when all_projects is enabled.

post.description: Requires separate ADMIN_API_KEY; project keys are rejected.

patch.description: Suspension disables project API authentication; incoming provider events remain accepted to avoid data loss.

delete.description: Permanently remove local customers, connections, conversations, messages, webhooks, events, requests and delivery records in one transaction. All tenant keys stop working. External provider accounts and numbers are retained. Deleted tenants are not recreated by environment bootstrap.

404.description: Tenant not found

get.description: Return up to 100 persisted events, newest first. Pass the returned event cursor in after to page backwards. Incoming messages, delivery statuses, Business App echoes and raw history/account updates are recorded here.
Return the latest 100 delivery attempts for the tenant. Includes pending, processing, delivered, failed and cancelled states. This endpoint does not use the resource-list cursor format.

post.description: Requeue a failed delivery for the authenticated tenant. Delivered or currently pending items cannot be retried with this operation.

get.description: Return tenant resource totals, 30-day message status counters and a zero-filled daily series. Dates use UTC. Disabled channel resources are excluded.
Returns Meta signup configuration and the current project identity for a valid, unexpired setup link. No project API key is required.

post.description: Complete an authorization from the hosted setup page using the Meta authorization code and selected connection type. This capability endpoint is restricted to the hosted origin. A partial provider failure preserves encrypted credentials for operator recovery.

Authenticate with an active console administrator email/password. Returns an opaque bearer session and its expiry. Sessions expire after 12 hours. Limited to 10 attempts per remote IP per minute per API process.
Revoke the supplied console session. The operation is idempotent.

get.description: Email/password sign-in and global console administrators. Sessions expire after 12 hours and are revoked on logout or password reset.

all_projects.description: Includes future projects. Admin with all_projects=true is a platform administrator.

project_ids.description: Explicit project access when all_projects is false.

post.description: Create a console user with a role and project access. Defaults to member with no projects; set project_ids or all_projects explicitly. Only platform administrators may manage console users.

all_projects.description: Includes future projects. Admin with all_projects=true is a platform administrator.

project_ids.description: Explicit project access when all_projects is false.

patch.description: Update activation, password, role or project assignments. Role and project changes affect existing sessions on their next request. Password reset revokes sessions. The last active platform administrator is protected.

delete.description: Permanently delete a console administrator and cascade deletion of their sessions. Does not delete tenant resources. Returns 409 when deleting the last active administrator.

404.description: User not found

409.description: Cannot delete the last active administrator

get.description: Return readiness and credential-presence booleans for the instance Meta application, plus the public API URL and configured Graph version. Does not return application secrets, access tokens or verification token values.
Returns the authenticated project identity and hosted setup link branding. A project is the same isolation boundary called a tenant in the administration API.

patch.description: Updates the project name or branding fields. Omitted fields are retained. Existing setup links use the latest saved branding. Accepts up to 8 MiB of JSON. Credentials and provider settings are separate.

get.description: Public raster logo asset addressed by its content hash. Use logo_url from project settings or the administration project list. Invalid hashes or removed logos return 404.

404.description: Logo not found

get.description: Returns current role and project assignments from the session. Requires a console session token; project API keys are not accepted.

Unified view of authenticated API requests, stored Meta/message events and the latest state of each webhook delivery. Returns up to 100 rows with cursor pagination. Search and filters run server-side within the authenticated project. API metadata logging excludes request bodies, headers, query strings, public routes and log reads themselves. Anonymous authentication failures cannot be attributed to a project and are not included. No historical API requests are reconstructed.
Returns routing metadata, an event payload, or the latest webhook delivery state. Secret-like fields in event payloads are redacted. Access is scoped to the current project.
Uses the project connection credentials. See docs/api-compatibility.md for ownership requirements and behavioral differences.

get.description: Aggregates stored messages for currently bound WhatsApp connections. Sent excludes failed and pending messages. Message counts use the selected UTC period; connection and conversation counts are current totals.

200.description: Counts, connection types and zero-filled daily series

404.description: Customer not found in this project

get.description: Returns the last cached report; the first request runs provider checks if none exists. Unknown checks never imply healthy billing.

200.description: Checks, issues, billing signals and checked_at

404.description: Connection not found

post.description: Checks credentials, phone access, account review, app subscription and Meta messaging health. Rate limited to one refresh per five seconds.

get.description: Latest 100 recorded state, category and quality changes for the connection WABA. Each event includes the previous snapshot and revision.

404.description: Connection not found

ApiKey.name: X-API-Key
ApiKey.description: Tenant API key generated in the console. Grants full access to one tenant.

BearerAuth.description: Tenant API key or console session. Administrator credentials require X-Tenant-ID when calling /v1 tenant resources.

credential_status.description: Current server-side validation state of the encrypted Meta credential.

access_token_expires_at.description: Known credential expiry reported by Meta. Omitted for non-expiring or unknown credentials.

external_id.description: Meta phone number ID, required for WhatsApp

access_token.description: Meta system-user or business token. Required for WhatsApp and encrypted at rest. Valid expiring system-user tokens are renewed before expiration when Meta permits it; expired tokens require reconnection.

timestamp.description: RFC3339 for local sends; Unix seconds for Meta events

onboarding_ready.description: Whether hosted WhatsApp onboarding is configured for this instance.

SetupLinkInput.description: Hosted customer authorization. Offer both connection types by default, or restrict the link to one. Link capabilities expire after 30 days by default.

all_projects.description: Includes future projects. Admin with all_projects=true is a platform administrator.

project_ids.description: Explicit project access when all_projects is false.

logo_data_url.description: PNG or JPEG base64 data URL, up to 5 MiB decoded and 4096 pixels per dimension. Empty string removes the logo. Remote URLs and SVG are rejected.

logo_url.description: Relative immutable public logo path, or an empty string when no logo is configured.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Businesses inside the authenticated tenant. External customer IDs are unique per tenant.

tags.name: Connections
tags.description: Authorized WhatsApp phone numbers. Access tokens are verified with Meta and encrypted at rest.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: Temporary hosted setup links. Offer Coexistence, a dedicated Cloud API number, or both.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Send and inspect messages. Use an Idempotency-Key to identify a logical send and reconcile uncertain provider outcomes.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Tenant-scoped message history, assignment and open/closed state.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Event subscriptions signed with HMAC-SHA256. Secrets are accepted on creation and omitted from reads.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Persisted project events and durable webhook delivery attempts.

tags.name: API keys
tags.description: Tenant-wide integration credentials. Full keys are returned once, on creation; revocation is immediate.

tags.name: Project
tags.description: Current tenant identity, enabled channel capabilities and activity totals.

tags.name: Console authentication
tags.description: Email/password sign-in and global console administrators. Sessions expire after 12 hours and are revoked on logout or password reset.

tags.name: Tenants
tags.description: Global administration of isolated workspaces. Requires an administrator credential.

tags.name: Administration
tags.description: Instance configuration and tenant administration. Secret configuration values are never returned.

tags.name: Compatibility
tags.description: Alternate platform and Graph-shaped routes for existing integrations. Prefer /v1 for new applications.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: Health checks without authentication. Readiness verifies PostgreSQL connectivity.

tags.name: Platform customers
tags.description: Customer CRUD using a wrapped platform request shape.

tags.name: Phone numbers
tags.description: Alternate WhatsApp phone number and per-number webhook routes.

tags.name: Graph API
tags.description: Versioned WhatsApp messages and templates using Graph-shaped resources.

tags.name: Platform setup
tags.description: Alternate routes for temporary setup-link capabilities.

tags.name: Observability
tags.description: Request telemetry, events and delivery state.

tags.name: Meta compatibility
tags.description: Project-scoped Meta operations. See the compatibility inventory for limitations.
